entry.title: HELMINTHOLTHUIS
entry.text: HELMINTHOLTHUIS, in natural history a name given by Lumana un pretrified bodies of rembling worms. Of the lie no reckons four genera. 1. Petrified li- thehyts, found in the mountains of Sweden. 2. Petirified shells. 3. Petrified zophytes. 4. Petrified reptiles.
